top_signal.title: Need a website for your business/project?
top_signal.summary: ​   Hey everyone, I’ve been building modern websites for businesses, startups, creators, and personal projects.   I can help with:   - Modern, responsive websites   - Landing pages   - Business/service websites   - Portfolio websites   - E-commerce   - CMS/admin panels   -Deployment & domain setup   I focus on clean design, good performance, and making the site actually useful for the business — not just making something that looks good.   If you’re looking for a website or want to improve an existing one, feel free to hire me, you can see my previous project in personal message.   Happy to discuss your idea and give you a straightforward quote.   (P.s. it costs less than 250 dollars)       submitted by     /u/StatementOdd7170       [link]       [comments]
